title: The Rewind: On The Couch
summary:
Macro Growth
It seems to be broadly accepted that overall economic growth will be slower in the
ahead than in the latter part of the 20th century. In particular, if growth remains slow, will it lead to slowing inflation, or even deflation? Will they employ credit, as in the past, to perpetuate growth in consumption?
